title: Suggestions (Console) Beta — Customer Cohort Sheet
body:
Last updated: 2026-02-20 (Chris Osei)

Purpose
- Track target customers for the Redwood Console “Suggestions” view beta (read-only) + ownership + enablement status + feedback themes.
- This is a working cohort list; not all rows will be enabled in prod.

Definitions / columns
- Enablement = allowlisted + feature flag suggestions_beta enabled (prod unless otherwise noted).
- Status values: Not contacted | Invited | Scheduled walkthrough | Enabled (staging) | Enabled (prod) | Paused | Declined
- Primary owners: AE (Account Exec), SE (Solutions Eng), CSM (Customer Success), TAM (Technical Account Manager)

Sheet
| Account / Company | Segment | Deployment mode | Regions in use | Primary use case | Account context (why them) | Owner (AE) | Owner (SE/TAM) | Owner (CSM) | Enablement status | Target week | Date enabled | RBAC verified? | Feedback notes / themes | Next steps |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| (Prospect) HubSpot 60319 — “Northbridge LegalTech” | Enterprise (prospect) | Hosted API (POC) | us-east-1 | Doc review + summarization (long context, strict latency) | Asked for clear savings attribution + auditability during technical deep dive; high potential for Dedicated | Markus Klein | Evan Scott | Rachel Kim | Scheduled walkthrough | Wk of 2026-02-24 | — | Pending | Wants “basis of estimate” to be exportable (or at least copyable). Concern: savings label feels like a promise; asked for confidence/intervals. (Ref: preview demo notes) | Schedule 45-min walkthrough; confirm if we can provide audit log evidence + “why this changed” copy. |
| HubSpot 60344 — “VarianceWorks” | Mid-market | Hosted API | us-west-2, eu-central-1 | Customer support chat (bursty traffic) | High traffic variance; explicitly cautious on risk; good test for risk taxonomy clarity | — | Liam O'Rourke (TAM) | Aparna Reddy | Invited | Wk of 2026-02-17 | — | N/A | In intro call, they asked: “Does high risk mean quality regression or SLO breach?” They want concrete rationale bullets (latency headroom, workload variance) and reversibility. | Get security/permissions confirmed; enable in staging first to validate telemetry freshness. |
| HubSpot 60401 — “SummitCommerce” | Mid-market (existing) | Dedicated | us-east-1 | Product Q&A + embeddings rerank | Existing Dedicated customer asking for cost visibility in Console; strong candidate to validate Dedicated route scoping | — | Markus Klein | Miguel Santos | Enabled (prod) | Wk of 2026-02-10 | 2026-02-12 | Yes (admin + read-only roles) | Early feedback: likes list filters by route/model; asked to default sort by “largest monthly impact.” Reported one suggestion that disappeared after 48h → likely telemetry freshness gap. | Have Logan/Nadia confirm baseline freshness; follow up with customer with explanation. |
| “Cedar Health Systems” | Enterprise | Private (VPC) | us-east-1 | Clinical note summarization | Regulated workload; good RBAC + audit logging validation; expects conservative messaging | — | Liam O'Rourke (TAM) | Rachel Kim | Enabled (staging) | Wk of 2026-02-24 | 2026-02-19 | In progress | Security team asked if savings view leaks usage patterns by route naming. Requested route name redaction option in screenshots for internal sharing. | Confirm with Naomi Feldman whether any additional masking needed for Private tenants; decide on prod enablement after 1 week. |
| “Orchid FinServe” | Enterprise | Dedicated | eu-west-1 | Fraud triage assistant (strict p95) | Great fit to pressure-test risk scoring: tight SLOs, latency-sensitive endpoints | — | Evan Scott | Miguel Santos | Paused | Wk of 2026-02-10 | 2026-02-13 (then paused 2026-02-14) | Yes | Paused after seeing multiple “Medium risk” caching suggestions; they felt risk too optimistic given p95 headroom. Requested “show headroom numbers” (even coarse) and explicit “rollback steps” copy. | Wait for risk calibration adjustment from Applied ML; re-enable after next weekly build if rationale improves. |
| “AlloyCX” | Startup (high growth) | Hosted API | us-east-1 | Sales email drafting + tool calling | High daily traffic; expects quick wins; likely to adopt suggestions quickly → good for adoption telemetry | — | Markus Klein | Aparna Reddy | Enabled (prod) | Wk of 2026-02-03 | 2026-02-05 | Yes | Strong positive: “This is the first time we can explain batching settings to leadership.” Wants one-click apply (not in beta). Confused by week-to-week savings change. | Send canned explanation for savings variance; add them to phase-2 apply waitlist. |
| “Kite Robotics” | Mid-market | Hosted API | us-west-2 | Support agent assist (short prompts, high QPS) | Good for batching recommendations; stable workload and clean baselines | — | Evan Scott | Miguel Santos | Enabled (prod) | Wk of 2026-02-03 | 2026-02-06 | Yes | Noted that the “estimated $/1M tokens” is useful but wants to see a before/after breakdown per route. Asked if savings double-counted when both caching + batching apply. | Confirm fix landed (double-counting regression) and point them to updated copy in detail drawer. |
| “BrightHire” | Mid-market | Hosted API | eu-central-1 | Interview summary + scoring rubric | Helpful to validate “insufficient telemetry” empty states (multiple routes, some low traffic) | — | Liam O'Rourke (TAM) | Aparna Reddy | Enabled (prod) | Wk of 2026-02-10 | 2026-02-11 | Yes | Filed question via CSM: Suggestions page says “insufficient telemetry” for an active route; likely metering pipeline delay. They asked for minimum requirements spelled out. | Have Logan Wright confirm telemetry freshness; share troubleshooting doc snippet with CSM. |
| “Evergreen Media” | SMB | Hosted API | us-east-1 | Content generation (high volume, low stakes) | Good for high adoption; low risk tolerance is lower (can accept some experimentation) | — | Markus Klein | Miguel Santos | Invited | Wk of 2026-02-24 | — | N/A | Wants clear disclaimer that savings are estimated and “not guaranteed.” Also asked if Suggestions will ever auto-apply. | Invite + schedule; ensure they understand read-only beta. |
| “AtlasEdTech” | Mid-market | Dedicated | us-east-1 | Tutor chat (seasonal spikes) | Great test for workload variance: seasonal / time-of-day patterns | — | Evan Scott | Aparna Reddy | Scheduled walkthrough | Wk of 2026-02-24 | — | Pending | In email, they asked whether suggestions are per region or global; want to filter by region and compare. | Walkthrough with focus on list filters + region scoping; set expectation around confidence intervals. |
| “Sable Security” | Enterprise | Private (on-prem) | on-prem | SOC triage assistant | Important for privacy posture; will scrutinize any usage-derived UI | — | Liam O'Rourke (TAM) | Rachel Kim | Not contacted | Wk of 2026-03-03 | — | N/A | Internal note: only enable after security review sign-off and audit logging verified end-to-end. | Naomi + Marcus to confirm security posture; then outreach via TAM. |
| “Juniper Travel” | Mid-market | Hosted API | ap-southeast-1 | Customer chat (multi-lingual) | Good to validate cross-region + language mix; some routes have long-tail languages | — | Markus Klein | Miguel Santos | Declined | Wk of 2026-02-17 | — | N/A | Declined for now: “We’re in a freeze; can’t evaluate optimization changes this quarter.” Still requested docs link for later. | Follow up in April; send docs-only link once beta docs are public. |

Rollup (working)
- Total listed: 12
- Enabled (prod): 4
- Enabled (staging): 1
- Scheduled/warm: 3
- Not contacted / declined: 4

Notes to self (open questions)
- Do we need a separate column for “Telemetry quality risk” vs “Performance/quality risk”? Customers seem to interpret “High risk” as “quality regression.”
- Consider adding a column for “Top suggestion types seen” (batching vs caching) after week 1 of each enablement.
- Make sure we’re consistently tracking realized-savings follow-ups for enabled accounts (tie to analytics events: suggestion viewed/adopted).
